messages:
Maya: Quick intake — planning bring-up for kestrel-7b-int4 (INT4 post-quant) for hosted + dedicated + private. Need a deployment + canary checklist and known gotchas for quantized models. Anyone with recent INT4 runs?
Arjun: I ran a small bench on INT4 yesterday. Latency down ~25% vs FP16, weird tail-p95 regressions on long prompts. Checklist idea: smoke evals, perf bench, safety evals, tokenization sanity, KV-cache integrity.
Lina: For private customers remember to include KMS key rotation steps and offline artifact signing in the checklist. Also ensure our installer toggles the qconfig correctly.
Sam: Do we have a canonical canary schedule? I usually do 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 60% over 24h with automatic rollback on error-rate or quality regression.
Priya: Add eval set for hallucination and instruction-following (small prompt bank we use in onboarding). Also include a scoring threshold for automatic rollback (e.g., >3% absolute drop in pass@1 or a 10% lift in hallucination rate).
Arjun: Short version of the rollout steps I propose:
```
1) Create route kestrel-7b-int4:stable in staging
2) Run smoke tests + token-by-token KV-cache test (script: tools/kv_check.sh)
3) Deploy to canary with 1% weight (hosted) or 1 instance in dedicated
4) Run streaming/edge-cases perf harness for 2h
5) Promote to 5% if no alerts, run full eval suite
6) 20% for 6h, 60% overnight, 100% next day
7) Monitor latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and eval metrics
Fallback: immediate switch to kestrel-7b-fp16 or previous stable model
```
Maya: Nice. For private deploys: how do we simulate dedicated traffic split?
Lina: For private you usually do a canary on a subset of tenant routes or spin a separate cluster with lower capacity and mirror 1% of traffic (traffic mirror) — mirror is safest, but you need to ensure we don't double-bill requests in metrics aggregation.
Sam: Metrics to watch: per-route token cost, per-request latency, unexpected OOMs, and 5xx errors. Also watch for prompt injections causing unexpected outputs — feed the security fuzz set.
Priya: On quantization experiments: keep both INT4 and FP16 checkpoints available in model catalog and tag experiments with quantization-recipe id. Log per-sample differences and create an A/B dump for any failing prompts.
Arjun: One gotcha I saw: INT4 can change beam search deterministic behavior slightly due to numeric changes — tests that assert exact string equality will fail. Use semantic similarity metrics (ROUGE/BLEU/embedding cosine) for rollout gating.
Maya: What about canary rollback triggers? Concrete thresholds:
- 5xx rate +0.1% absolute or x2 baseline
- latency p95 increases >20% for 10m
- eval metric drop >3% absolute OR hallucination increase >10% relative
- OOM or pod restarts >1 in 5m
- manual veto by oncall/SDR
Arjun: Add infra triggers: GPU temperature, throttling, and host OOM logs (for dedicated). Also autoscaler misfiring: spike in queue length for >5m.
Lina: Private-specific checklist items:
- Ensure HSM/KMS binding for the model key
- Validate offline artifact signature before load
- Confirm logging to customer's SIEM or our audit sink per contract
- Run conformance test with the customer's sample workload (1000 requests)
Sam: For monitoring, set up ephemeral dashboards during rollout: per-canary-group p50/p95, token/sec, queue length, and sample output diffs (attach failing prompt examples).
Priya: For quant experiments include a tiny fuzz harness that runs 500 random prompts and checks output divergence distribution. Add a step to run the eval harness on historical prompt set used by that customer (if available).
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: rollout-checklist/kestrel-7b-int4 -> job #7845 (staging smoke at 1%). ETA: 10m.
Maya: Who wants to own the first canary? I'll take it if Arjun can watch metrics for the first 6h. Lina can handle private artifact steps. Priya owns eval gating and A/B dump. Sam, please prep dashboards.
Arjun: I'll watch metrics and be ready to rollback.
Lina: I'll start the private deployment playbook and upload signed artifacts.
Sam: Dashboards ready in ~30m, sending links when up.
Priya: Eval harness queued; will post summary after the 5% stage.
Maya: Perfect — thanks team. I'll update the model onboarding ticket with this checklist and assign tasks. :thumbsup:
